title: Privacy: a cloud erase whose session changed during the engine call, or that came back with no view, never reaches showErased: the store does not count it, and it keeps the record it held before the erase
evidence: Privacy item; own PR after PR 1599 merges. From the adversary reviews of PR 1599 (F6, re-check F3). ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift erase returns before showErased when connection.shownSession moved or result.view is nil, so erasures does not move and the store's record is the one it held before. DataEraser then runs its Apple Health, units and reminders steps on that record. Narrow: the engine sends a view whenever it erased (ios/engine/cloud.ts), and Connect and Disconnect are refused while an erase runs (US-25 AC16e). Outside PR 1599's rule (it covers an erase the store has taken in). Needs a decision on what the store holds in that case. US-25 AC16
